thread:
mira: quick idea — tiny thank-you badges we can drop in threads for small wins. wanna test? :seedling:

devon: love it. do we have a list of badges or is it freeform?

mira: freeform to start. i'll seed a tiny legend: `:seedling:` for helping plants, `:anchor:` for keeping things stable, `:coffee:` for late-night saves, `:wrench:` for debugging heroics

samir: i nominate @elaine for :coffee: — saved my demo at 11:45pm last night 🙌

elaine: aww thanks! that was panicking + logging, lol :sweat_smile:

jun: can the bot keep score? would be fun to glance at before all-hands

appreciation-bot: Badge recorded: :coffee: awarded to elaine by samir (1 point).

devon: also awarding @mira a :seedling: for starting this. tiny but nice :heart_eyes:

appreciation-bot: Badge recorded: :seedling: awarded to mira by devon (1 point).

samir: proposal: monthly "sprout" leaderboard, but keep it silly. no prizes, just stickers

mira: perfect. ops-team pls don't use it to track performance pls :joy: (obligatory)

devon: agreed. optional and public kudos only

elaine: can we add `:wrench:` for debugging heroics?

jun: done — here's a quick slash command mock if folks want to try: `/badge @name :wrench: reason: fixed staging deploy`

devon: lol i tried `/badge` locally and broke nothing — success!

appreciation-bot: Reminder: review badges for accuracy at the end of the day. Use `/badge-undo` to revert.

mira: ok small poll: who wants a monthly tiny-badges recap in #general? :hand:

devon: vote yes

samir: yes please

elaine: yes

jun: no strong opinion but ok

mira: awesome. i'll draft the recap template and ping comms. thanks all — this made my morning :sparkles:

devon: :emoji-party: also, gif — https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA

appreciation-bot: Badge recorded: :wrench: awarded to devon by elaine (1 point).

mira: closing thread — we'll roll a tiny-badges channel next week for testing. feel free to keep dropping badges here in the meantime.
